runtimeAssessment.reason: 51 valid, distinct native EGiB parcel polygons across thirteen bounded cells around the unchanged Poznań WUP settlement locator. Before/after hit counts, all feature pages, forced three-row pagination, fresh exact reads of every ID, explicit absence, footprint lookup and one-parcel proposal binding pass. Independent EPSG:2180 full-polygon topology audit found no invalidity, duplicate geometry, overlaps above 0.01 m² or operation errors. This verifies bounded reference geometry, without asserting whole-city completeness.
